conclusions.lordchrist-history-spurgeon-down-grade: CONFIRM_WITH_BOUNDARY: doctrinal character is strongly supported; retain explicit limitation that Spurgeon's account does not prove every opponent's motive or argument.
conclusions.lordchrist-history-bunyan-bedford-prison: CONFIRM_WITH_QUALIFICATION: imprisonment is archival; prison-writing relationship is strong, but exact composition-place claims for Pilgrim's Progress remain qualified/reputed rather than exact.
conclusions.lordchrist-history-judson-burmese-bible: DEEPEN: 2024 scholarship materially strengthens the correction that Judson did not translate in an intellectual vacuum; earlier Catholic/Barnabite and British Baptist resources were real inputs.
conclusions.lordchrist-history-spurgeon-cholera-1854: CONFIRM: autobiographical and institutional evidence supports pastoral visits during the 1854 epidemic; retain prohibition on modern medical extrapolation.
conclusions.lordchrist-history-carey-enquiry-mission: CONFIRM_WITH_NONCAUSAL_BOUNDARY: Enquiry and 1792 society formation are strong; keep collective/multifactor framing rather than a single-founder myth.
conclusions.lordchrist-history-fuller-gospel-worthy: CONFIRM_WITH_NONCAUSAL_BOUNDARY: 1785 text is secure; Oxford scholarship reinforces that renewal and missions had multiple interacting causes.
conclusions.lordchrist-history-tyndale-translation-m: CONFIRM_AND_DEEPEN: arrest, 16-month imprisonment and 1536 execution are strongly supported; continue excluding famous last-word formulas unless separately primary-bound.
conclusions.lordchrist-history-stam-china-martyrdom: CONFIRM_AND_CORRECT_COPY: Wheaton and Princeton archival records independently support the mission/martyrdom context; replace ambiguous 'детский safe' wording with exact description of the surviving-child telegram and archival papers.
conclusions.lordchrist-history-sattler-schleitheim-m: CONFIRM_WITH_HISTORIOGRAPHIC_BOUNDARY: Schleitheim date/content and May 1527 death are supported; do not inflate detailed execution narrative beyond the bound evidence.
